findings.title: LinesConnection.fetch lacks parameter/return types
findings.problem: code-quality.md Types And Imports requires explicit parameter and return types in new code. The new LinesConnection.fetch(self, sql: str, *args) leaves *args unannotated and declares no return type.
findings.impact: Breaks a documented blocking standard for new code. Ruff's selected rules have no ANN check, so no automated gate catches it.
findings.recommendation: Conform to code-quality.md Types And Imports: annotate `*args: object` and add a return type that matches what `RecordingConnection.fetch` returns (e.g. `-> list[Any]`).
findings.check_notes: test_ingestor.py is in changed_files; at HEAD line 954 reads `async def fetch(self, sql: str, *args: object) -> list[object]`

findings.title: _cowork_figures uses bare dict annotations
findings.problem: code-quality.md Types And Imports says to avoid bare dict annotations. _cowork_figures is annotated -> tuple[dict, dict, dict, set[str]].
findings.impact: Breaks a documented blocking standard for new code. No automated gate catches it.
findings.recommendation: Conform to code-quality.md Types And Imports: annotate the return as `tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], set[str]]`. `Any` is already imported at line 34.
findings.check_notes: test_live_route_pricing.py is in changed_files; at HEAD lines 856-858 return `tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], set[str]]`

findings.title: MR description misstates fixture contents
findings.problem: The spec (MR description) says the fixture has one typed prompt and three tool calls, one of them with changed lines. The fixture has two typed prompts (u1, u3) and two lines-changing tool calls: Write 3/0 (tu1) and Edit 2/1 (tu3). The fixture's own docstring and the test assertions (net_lines 4, turns 2) agree with the fixture.
findings.impact: A partial spec requirement. Reviewers and later maintainers get a wrong account of what the regression fixture covers. The tests themselves stay consistent.
findings.recommendation: Change the MR description to match the fixture: two prompts the user typed (u1, u3) plus one auto prompt, and three tool calls of which two change lines (Write 3/0 and Edit 2/1). The fixture docstring and the test assertions (net_lines 4, turns 2) already agree with the fixture. Change the fixture only if one lines-changing call was the intent.
findings.check_notes: mapped artifact spec.md is non-empty; line 88 now says two typed prompts plus an auto prompt and three tool calls, two with changed lines, which matches the fixture; mapped command exit_code 0

If nothing covers it, add those tests in that repository before the story closes. This backend MR cannot meet those criteria alone.
